title: Efficacy of orthokeratology lens with the modified small treatment zone on myopia progression and visual quality: a randomized clinical trial

groups.description: modified three-zone small-treatment-zone (STZ) orthokeratology lens (HDS 100, BOZD 6.0 mm), randomised 1:1, Qingdao Eye Hospital, China; ages 8-12 years; mean age of the analysed set (Table 1)

conventional four-zone reverse-geometry treatment-zone (CTZ) orthokeratology lens (Alpha Corp., BOZD 6.0 mm), randomised 1:1, Qingdao Eye Hospital, China; ages 8-12 years; mean age of the analysed set (Table 1)

exclusions.what: Table 1 sphere, astigmatism, SER, UCVA, pupil diameter; Table 2 SER/UCVA at 1 month, HOA, spherical aberration and treatment-zone/defocus topography rows; Table 3 OQAS-II optical quality
exclusions.reason: not axial length (protocol inclusion 1); mentioned here only

exclusions.what: Table 2 t and P values; regression coefficients (Table S2, text)
exclusions.reason: p-values and model estimates are not admissible (protocol inclusion 4)
figure only; the same means are tabulated in Table 2

notes: Randomised double-masked trial (ChiCTR1900027218), Qingdao, China; recruitment from January 2021; 18-month follow-up; AL by IOLMaster 500 at baseline and every visit.
Per-group randomised numbers are derived from the reported total (140, 1:1) and the per-group losses (2 STZ, 7 CTZ) with 68 and 63 analysed; the flow diagram (Fig. 2) is an image.
Refraction, UCVA, corneal topography and optical-quality data are tabulated but are not axial length.

series.notes: mean ± SD (raw, tables state mean ± SD; ANCOVA used only for tests); right eye of each child only (Statistical analysis); IOLMaster 500; analysed set = children who completed follow-up: 140 randomised 1:1, 2 STZ children lost to follow-up and excluded, so 68 of 70 randomised (97%) are tabulated (protocol inclusion 5: >=70%, admitted); baseline and follow-up n = 68
